source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free high-top sneaker, one stable three-quarter side view, one toe cap, one thick sole, one tongue, one ankle collar, exactly six visible eyelets, one crisscross lace path, exactly two loose lace ends, side seams, four tread notches, and one broken shadow stable.

process_strategy: Reserve the tongue and lace footprint inside the upper, construct the shoe and sole first, place all eyelets, laces, seams, and tread details in light line before inking, introduce the limited canvas palette before the final panel, and finish with line-weight and fill cleanup only.

final_elements.name: sole foot ankle tongue lace and shadow guides
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes the sole baseline, foot box, high ankle envelope, tongue footprint, toe-cap curve, six visible eyelet positions, lace route, and broken shadow.

final_elements.name: complete high-top sneaker silhouette
final_elements.description: One three-quarter side-view high-top with rounded toe cap, thick sole, heel, ankle collar, and tongue.

final_elements.name: six visible eyelets crisscross laces and two loose ends
final_elements.description: Exactly six visible eyelets along the near side, one clear crisscross lace path across the tongue, and exactly two loose lace ends resting above the toe.

final_elements.name: side seams sole stripe and four tread notches
final_elements.description: A curved side panel seam, heel seam, one sole stripe, and exactly four visible tread notches complete the light detail pass.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces every established shoe contour, lace, eyelet, seam, sole detail, and the reserved broken shadow.

final_elements.name: forest green cream rust and navy marker fills
final_elements.description: Forest-green canvas, cream toe cap sole and laces, rust-orange ankle lining, and a muted navy shadow with visible marker streaks and paper highlights.

final_step.visible_job: Only thickens selected established edges, evens existing marker fills, deepens the broken shadow, and clarifies paper highlights without changing the shoe shape, lace route, counts, seams, or colors.

deeper tone inside the established broken shadow
light removal of pale construction guides

rejection_checks: Keep the same single face-free high-top sneaker, three-quarter side view, toe direction, crop, scale, sole angle, tongue, and shadow footprint in all six panels.
Exactly six visible eyelets, one crisscross lace path, two loose lace ends, one sole stripe, and four tread notches must appear before bold ink or color and persist.
Reserve the tongue and lace footprint before drawing the surrounding upper; do not draw finished canvas seams underneath covering laces.
Do not add a second shoe, leg, foot, sock, face, logo, brand mark, text, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, sticker outline, or badge frame.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean footwear icon art or polished product rendering.
